definitions.gloss: for a period of; over the span of
definitions.explanation: Suffix attaching to a time-unit phrase to express duration ('for X days/weeks/years'). Makes the time expression explicitly a span rather than a point in time.

examples.japanese: {三日|みっか}{間|かん}⟦{休|やす}んだ→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
⟦{一週|いっしゅう}{間|かん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'll go on a trip for one week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{三年|さんねん}{間|かん}→三年間：28861_sannenkan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{最|もっと}も→最も：01736_mottomo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧な⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧だった。
examples.english: The three years I spent studying abroad were the most important period of my life.

notes:
Attaches to time-unit counters to mark a duration. Compare ⟦{十日|とおか}→十日：02917_tooka⟧ (the tenth of the month) vs. {十日|とおか}{間|かん} (for ten days).

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{一週|いっしゅう}{間|かん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧: for one week
- {三日|みっか}{間|かん}: for three days
- {十年|じゅうねん}{間|かん}: for ten years
- ⟦{数|すう}{時間|じかん}→数時間：21622_suujikan⟧: for several hours
- ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧: for a long time (read あいだ, not かん)

USAGE:
Not used with point-in-time expressions (⟦{三時|さんじ}→三時：10983_sanji⟧, ⟦{月曜日|げつようび}→月曜日：00624_getsuyoubi⟧). When the time unit already implies duration (⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧, ⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧), {間|かん} is built in and not added again.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧: interval; while — different reading, refers to the time/space between two points
